function.name: feishu_reply_media
function.description: Reply to the current Feishu conversation with a local image or file. The path must be inside the configured workspace or the Feishu channel session directory.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to the file to send.

kind.description: How to send the local file. auto sends common image files as Feishu image messages and everything else as file messages.

file_type.description: Optional Feishu file_type override for file uploads, such as pdf, doc, xls, ppt, mp4, opus, or stream.
